## `FileLock`

```silk
pub struct FileLock
```

Owns an exclusive advisory lock. Dropping it releases the lock; the lock file remains.

### Associated function `exclusive`

pub effect fn exclusive(path: &Path) -> Self ! FileError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator

Creates or opens the lock file and waits for its exclusive lock.
The parent directory must exist. All participants must lock the same persistent file.
